source_rule: Java client globals/classes and injected mutable accessors
rust_decision: Typed IDs; GameState single writer; immutable projections; versioned sandboxed plugin queries/events/commands
benefit: Explicit ownership, safety and shared native/web semantics
observable_difference: Internal/API implementation shape differs; applicable game/plugin effects remain required
remaining: Verify each mapped observable contract; architecture alone is not parity evidence.

source_rule: RuneLite may retain a collapsed navigation rail
rust_decision: Hide panel and rail together with zero reserved game width
observable_difference: Closed shell has no visible navigation rail
remaining: Repeat native/browser layout/input acceptance for the selected backend; GPU-shell WIP does not inherit CPU-backend acceptance.

source_rule: RuneLite Swing chrome; earlier RustClient CPU DOM panel
rust_decision: On-demand egui texture on the existing GPU with retained unchanged frames
benefit: Measured CPU hover cost motivates the replacement
observable_difference: Toolkit differs; controls, focus, text/IME/clipboard and effects must remain equivalent
remaining: Integrated at bd3aae10; measure replacement cost and verify full controls/platform behavior before acceptance.

source_rule: classMG.method7611 runs at most ten due cycles, then drops debt with a strict next-deadline comparison
rust_decision: Shared application CycleClock adopts the inspected ten-cycle nanosecond-clock rule
benefit: Shared explicit deterministic scheduling and bounded catch-up
observable_difference: None intended by this clock policy; complete runtime ordering and live acceptance remain open
remaining: Verify native/browser runtime acceptance and finish the remaining SPEC-0020 stages; no full-cycle parity claim.

source_rule: Stock collects pick candidates during model draw (viewport mouse tags)
rust_decision: Ray picking against posed CPU geometry (crates/scene/src/picking.rs)
observable_difference: Candidate set or order may differ from stock for overlapping or thin geometry
remaining: Compare menu entry lists with the reference bridge on recorded states; accept only if equal.

source_rule: 240 state-30 map rebuild draws the previous scene with no loading box (classKK.method6533); 235 state 25 draws the box over the frozen frame (class167.method4165, HttpMethod.drawLoadingMessage)
rust_decision: Keep the retired scene drawn and show the stock 235 box only after the replacement has loaded for 250 ms
benefit: User asked for a loading message during region loads without a black screen
observable_difference: A box appears over the frozen scene during slow rebuilds; stock 240 shows none
remaining: Confirm in a live walk across a region boundary; remove the box if the user prefers pure 240.

source_rule: CS2 ops 7250/7252/7253/7254 are used by the cache's settings scripts but are absent from the pinned 240 deob jar
rust_decision: Implement MINIMAP_SETZOOMABLE/SETZOOM/GETZOOM/SETICONZOOMLIMIT from the 241 reference client semantics: zoomable flag resets the scale to 4, zoom is ignored unless zoomable and clamps to 2..8, GETZOOM returns the whole step
benefit: The cache is newer than the 240 jar, so its scripts would otherwise abort the settings pages
observable_difference: None intended for scripts that run on both clients; the minimap now renders, clicks and places markers at the committed scale
remaining: Wire the mouse wheel (quarter steps) once a plugin or script owns that input; confirm against a 241 capture.

source_rule: CS2 ops 1133-1146 configure text-input fields (classBB.method807/808 on classLH/classLI) and the all-settings list builder script 3850 calls eight of them
rust_decision: Consume the operand and keep no field state; the ops are accepted so the row builder finishes instead of aborting after CcDeleteall
benefit: Without them the whole settings page truncated and lost its scroll position; stock ignores them on widgets that are not input fields
observable_difference: Input-field rows are drawn but cannot be edited in place; typed settings still work through the chatbox prompts
remaining: Model input-field widgets (focus, caret, max length, character filter) in GameState and route key events to them.

source_rule: DEVICEOPTION_GETRANGE (3217) in the pinned jar knows device option ids 2-6 and 14; the cache's script 7106 asks for option 20
rust_decision: Use the jar's ranges for known ids; return 100..400 for option 20 (interface scaling) as the TSPS 241 client does; reject other ids as stock does
benefit: The cache is newer than the jar and script 7106 would abort a settings build otherwise
observable_difference: Option 20 is a guess from the 241 client's scaling option; its numbering there is 27
remaining: Confirm option 20 against a 241 capture or the cache's own scripts using it.

source_rule: CC_SETMODELTRANSPARENT/CC_GETMODELTRANSPARENT store a flag that draws a model translucent
rust_decision: Accept the setter and discard the operand; the getter answers 0
benefit: Scripts that set it no longer abort their interface
observable_difference: Model widgets are drawn opaque and the getter does not return what was set
remaining: Add the flag to the model widget body and draw it translucent.

rust_decision: Use a SplitMix64 source with a fixed default seed; the host may call ClientScripts::seed_random
benefit: Deterministic scripts and replays; no hidden entropy
observable_difference: Scripts that roll dice repeat the same sequence on every launch until a host seeds them
remaining: Seed from the native host at login.

source_rule: MINIMAP_SETICONZOOMLIMIT (7254) is absent from the pinned 240 deob jar and the 241 client only stores the value
rust_decision: Draw minimap icons only while the whole-step zoom is at least the limit (default 0 draws them always)
benefit: The settings scripts that set the limit take effect instead of being ignored
observable_difference: The comparison direction is inferred from the op's name; a client that hides icons when zoomed in would differ
remaining: Confirm the direction against a 241 capture or a cache script that sets a limit.

source_rule: FROMDATE formats 86400000*(11745+days) ms with Calendar.getInstance() in the host time zone
benefit: Script output does not depend on the machine's time zone; replays stay deterministic
observable_difference: West of UTC the reference shows the previous day; RustClient always shows the UTC day
remaining: None unless a live comparison shows scripts depend on the local day.

rust_decision: Consume both operands and discard them
benefit: Settings scripts that set the speeds run instead of aborting
observable_difference: None while the oculus orb camera is absent; once it exists the speeds must be stored
remaining: Store the speeds when the oculus orb camera mode is implemented.

source_rule: CC_SETNPCHEAD/CC_SETPLAYERHEAD_SELF set modelType 2/3 and draw the NPC or local player chathead (235 Varcs)
rust_decision: Retain the head source on WidgetRuntime::head; model widgets are not painted yet
benefit: Dialogue and other head interfaces mount instead of aborting their scripts
observable_difference: Chathead widgets stay blank, as every model widget does today
remaining: Paint model widgets, then resolve heads from NPC definitions and the local appearance.

source_rule: STOCKMARKET_* read Client.grandExchangeOffers, eight slots filled by UPDATE_STOCKMARKET_SLOT
rust_decision: Answer every slot as the empty offer the reference starts with (state 0)
benefit: Grand Exchange interfaces mount instead of aborting
observable_difference: Real offers never appear until packet 103 is decoded
remaining: Decode UPDATE_STOCKMARKET_SLOT into GameState and read it here.

source_rule: Stock picks ground item piles by the ItemLayer model's mouse tag
rust_decision: List the hovered terrain tile's items in the world menu, newest first, above Walk here
benefit: Items can be taken although piles are not drawn yet
observable_difference: Items show only when the pointer is over their tile, not over a pile model that overhangs the tile edge; their order among NPC/location entries on the same tile is fixed
remaining: Pick pile models once they are drawn.

source_rule: Stock builds an ItemLayer of the top three items of each pile (classLJ.method7159) with count variants and customisation
rust_decision: Ground items are authoritative state, menus, actions and minimap dots only; no scene model is drawn
benefit: Pickup, plugins and minimap work without the pile renderer
observable_difference: Items are invisible in the 3D scene
remaining: Add pile models to the scene projection with the stock value ordering.
